newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovakia posts SKK 26.98 bln 1996 deficit - TASR.
newsitem.headline: Slovakia posts SKK 26.98 bln 1996 deficit - TASR.

text.p: Slovakia's 1996 budget deficit totalled 26.98 billion crowns, just below the government's forecast deficit for the year of 27 billion crowns, the official TASR news agency said on Wednesday.
TASR quoted finance ministry spokesman Jozef Mach as saying the budget revenues in 1996 totalled 164.6 billion crowns and expenditures were 191.6 billion.
Finance ministry officials were not immediately available for additional comment.
Original government plans estimated revenues at 165.46 billion crowns and expenditures at 192.46 billion.
Last November Finance Minister Sergej Kozlik said overall budget revenues were expected to be lower by some two billion crowns than originally planned.
Slovakia's state budget deficit totalled 12.9 billion crowns for the January-October period, down from 13.4 billion in the first nine months of 1996. -- Bratislava newsroom, 42-7-563-3687
